signals.text: With the freedom to develop our own curriculum, students explore subjects in depth, whether using the extensive Bedales campus to investigate ecosystems in Outdoor Work, staging Shakespeare in English, undertaking forensic investigations in Science, or designing and making furniture in the Design Barn.

signals.text: From Block 4, students study a core of GCSE examined subjects alongside innovative Bedales Assessed Courses (BACs), which encourage intellectual curiosity, independent thinking, and creative expression - preparing students for further learning and future challenges.

signals.text: At Bedales Senior, academic subjects are grouped in 10 faculties to provide a broad and inspiring curriculum, so students can pursue their interests, develop key skills and prepare for life beyond school.
